title: 1RB0LC_1RC1RA_1RD0RF_0LE---_1LA1LE_0RA1LD: one pulse over any list of words, in Lean
text: Lean (kernel only): for every list of words 01/011 and every tape around, L | A> ws 0111 R reaches L | A> 111 ws 0 R in 10(|ws|+1) steps, so a fuse 1^(k+3) after any stretch of words becomes 1^k; a pulse that meets 0001 halts the machine.
